[SWS_CM_10380] Silently discarding SOME/IP event messages for unsub- scribed events
⌈
If the event identified according to [SWS_CM_10325] does not have
an active subscription because the Subscribe method (see [SWS_CM_00141]) of
the specific Field class of the ServiceProxy class has not been called, or the
Unsubscribe method (see [SWS_CM_00151]) of the specific Field class of the
ServiceProxy class has been called, or the TTL of the SOME/IP SubscribeEvent- group message (see [SWS_CM_00205]) has expired, the received SOME/IP event
message shall be silently discarded (i.e., [SWS_CM_10326], [SWS_CM_10327], and
[SWS_CM_10328] shall not be performed).
⌋
